implemented-requirements.description: Active Directory domain controllers enforce account creation and approval processes. Accounts are reviewed quarterly by the system owner.
System configuration baselines are captured in Git repositories and managed via infrastructure-as-code. Gold images are hardened to the current DISA STIG.
System access requires active CAC card authentication for all interactive logons.
Multi-factor tokens are verified locally by the identity provider system layer before session establishment.
Configuration settings are enforced through group policy and configuration management tools. Deviations require documented risk acceptance.
